description: Batch check whether recent official JMA earthquake shaking reached a threshold at your Japan sites. Pass up to 50 prefectures or 7-digit JMA city codes, optionally labeled (HQ:Tokyo,Plant:Aichi); omit for all 47 prefectures. Returns per-site status none/felt/check/severe, max intensity and strongest event. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402.

sites.description: Comma-separated sites, e.g. HQ:Tokyo,Plant:Aichi,27,4320500. Omit for all 47 prefectures.

threshold.description: JMA intensity that counts as impact: 1, 2, 3, 4 (default), 5-, 5+, 6-, 6+, 7

name: check_japan_earthquake_impact
